text:
nina: quick ping for UX review on the updated Usage & Billing draft in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/YYY. Focus areas: spend chart prominence, token breakdown grouping, where invoices live, and org vs project scoping. need quick takes by tomorrow noon.

omar: first glance: the stacked area trend should be the hero. the large donut on the right is visually heavy and clashes with small token rows. suggest moving donut down and making the trend full-width. also add a tiny sparkline in the token rows for quick trend context.

riley: about token grouping 1: collapse models that are <2% of spend into an "Other (n)" bucket, but allow expand-by-click to show the full list. that helps initial scannability. also order rows by dollar impact not token count.

pat: invoice UX: users commonly ask where PDFs are. prefer a dedicated "Invoices" quick action in the top-right with a dropdown: Recent invoices, Download PDF (current scope), Billing history. When scope is Project, the dropdown should default to project invoices. add a small badge if a new invoice is available.

lee: accessibility checklist: color contrast for stacked areas (use palettes safe for deuteranopia), keyboardable invoice menu, aria-describedby for the spend chart summary, and ensure tooltips are reachable via focus. focus order should flow filters -> time range -> chart -> rows -> invoice actions.

omar: copy nits: swap "Estimated charges" -> "Estimated charges (preliminary)" and add helper: "Final invoices posted within 48 hours of month end." Invoice CTA: "Download PDF".

riley: data note: frontend should default to finalized billing numbers on the Billing overview; show a small realtime indicator when using near-real-time counters. this avoids confusion during month-end adjustments.

deploy-bot: preview build deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/usage-billing-v4  commit: b2c9a8. Screenshots attached in the preview.

nina: plan & owners: 1) promote time-series to full width + move donut to secondary (owner: omar) - due Tue 11am; 2) implement collapse-to-other with expand interaction and top-5-by-spend (owner: riley/jordan) - riley to spec API response; 3) invoice quick-action and scope-aware defaults (owner: pat) - include badge logic; 4) a11y fixes (owner: lee) - include color tokens and focus order; 5) copy updates (owner: omar) - update tooltip and helper lines. i'll update Figma and tag PRs.

pat: can we also add a tiny breadcrumb under the main header to surface current billing period and scope? saves clicks for people toggling org/project.

nina: great idea, add it to the mock. thanks everyone 44D

pat: i'll own QA once staging is live. checklist: keyboard nav, print-to-PDF, invoice download validation at project/org boundaries.

lee: will run a quick contrast pass and share color tokens by EOD.
